name: Cheergirl Shuudan Rape ~Gohoushi Niku Dorei~
original_name: チアガール集団レイプ～ご奉仕肉奴隷～
source:
Main heroine is a cheerleader for the baseball school team. One team member loses motivation before the game, so girl offers him sex to cheer him up. Motivation increases, and team indeed wins. But two more team members demand equal treatment...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是学校棒球队的啦啦队队员。赛前一名队员失去了干劲，她便献上身体为他鼓劲加油。重振士气的队员果然带领球队赢得了胜利，谁知另外两名队员见状，也纷纷要求享受同等待遇……
